text:
Marta (Finance): FYI we've got 3 customers reporting being charged twice for February invoices. Payment portal shows two distinct invoice PDFs with same invoice_number=INV-2026-02-1987 but different totals (one includes a $0.00 adjustment line).

Riley (Support): customer report: customer_id=PLUM-553. They uploaded both PDFs. One has total $3,450.00, the other $3,450.00 too but payment gateway captured twice. They want reversal.

invoicing-bot: finalization_job fj_2026_02_19 status=completed duplicate_detected=true retried_jobs=1

Evan (Billing): when you say duplicate, is that invoice_number collision or same external_id posted twice?

Marta (Finance): looks like same invoice_number reused, but pdf_checksum differs. database invoice records show two rows: invoice.id=inv_9811 and inv_9812 both with invoice_number=INV-2026-02-1987 and different internal_line_set ids.

Sam (Engineering): hmm. that suggests idempotency key for finalization wasn't honored on the second run. Any clues why finalizer retried?

invoicing-bot: scheduler:finalizer retried job=fj_2026_02_19 due_to=partial_failure task=pdf-generation

Marta (Finance): manual note: we have a partial failure alert for pdf-generation between 03:04-03:07 UTC and the scheduler retried at 03:09. Both runs wrote invoices and the second run didn't check existing invoice_number records before creating.

Evan (Billing): immediate ask: can we mark the duplicate invoice rows as voided and trigger refunds for payments that were captured twice? We should also block any auto-collection until this is fixed.

Sam (Engineering): ok emergency rollback plan: (1) disable finalizer auto-retry flag, (2) add unique constraint on (invoice_number, customer_id) in a safe way with backfill of duplicates, (3) run idempotency fix to check external_run_id. I can do (1) now.

Riley (Support): I've told PLUM-553 we'll escalate and issue a refund if billing confirms. They asked for a timeline.

Sam (Engineering): disabled auto-retry at 2026-03-02T04:12Z. Opening PR for idempotency check + constraint. Will also add a quick script to find invoice_number duplicates created in last 30 days.

Marta (Finance): please also generate a list of affected customers and amounts so we can coordinate refunds and CS messages. Ticket FIN-1620 opened.

Evan (Billing): running query to collect duplicates now:
```
SELECT invoice_number, customer_id, array_agg(id) as ids, sum(amount) as combined
FROM invoices
WHERE created_at > now() - interval '30 days'
GROUP BY invoice_number, customer_id
HAVING count(*) > 1;
```

Evan (Billing): query returned 3 groups: INV-2026-02-1987 (PLUM-553), INV-2026-02-1990 (ORBIT-21), INV-2026-02-2005 (NOVA-9). Totals look identical per row; payment_status shows captured on two invoice ids for PLUM-553.

Riley (Support): ok I'm drafting refund messages for those three customers and putting temporary hold on collections for their accounts.

Sam (Engineering): update: PR #412 adds check in finalizer: if invoice_number exists for customer and status != voided, abort creation and attach job_id to existing invoice row. Also adding migration to dedupe historical duplicates by marking the later-created as voided with reason 'serial_collision'. Will run in staging first.

Marta (Finance): please include a CSV export of all duplicate invoice ids and payment transaction ids for accounting. We'll process refunds and post reversing journal entries.

Evan (Billing): exported CSV and uploaded to finance-secure s3://redwood-finance/FIN-1620/duplicates.csv. Includes invoice ids, amounts, transaction ids, and refund_status blank.

Sam (Engineering): deployed idempotency check to staging; tests pass. Scheduling production deploy after 1h maintenance window. Also scheduling a short downtime for finalizer to run the dedupe backfill.

Marta (Finance): good. after backfill we'll reconcile with payments and confirm refunds. tracking this under FIN-1620 and will update the monthly close notes.

Riley (Support): customers notified and refunds queued where payment provider supports immediate refund. PLUM-553 confirmed.

Evan (Billing): follow-up: please add a regression test to cover retried job path and ensure invoice_number uniqueness is preserved when pdf-generation fails and retries occur.

Sam (Engineering): will add regression and an integration test that simulates partial pdf write then retry.

Marta (Finance): closing actions: (1) refunds for affected customers, (2) patch + deploy idempotency, (3) add DB constraint and backfill, (4) add regression tests. I'll close FIN-1620 when refunds are completed. Thanks all.
